title: Ox Passion Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Salts Strawberry Raspberry Cherry blends three bold berry flavours for a rich and indulgent vape. The inhale brings the smooth, ripe sweetness of Strawberry, followed by the sharp, tangy notes of Raspberry, while deep, juicy Cherry rounds out the exhale with its distinctive, slightly dark fruit profile. Blended in a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, offering a smooth throat hit with full-bodied flavour. Perfect for pod vape kits and starter devices, it ensures rapid nicotine absorption for a consistently satisfying vape experience. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping technology, the OX Passion Salts range features expertly crafted flavours designed to pair seamlessly with Oxva’s XLIM pod kits and other refillable vape devices.
